2607.18311.title: Approximating SPR Distance Between Phylogenetic Trees with Graph Neural Networks
2607.18311.paper_summary: Comparing phylogenetic tree topologies is essential for understanding epidemic dynamics, yet biologically meaningful distances such as the Subtree Prune and Regraft (SPR) distance are NP-hard to compute and intractable on large datasets. We investigate whether a Graph Neural Network (GNN) can approximate SPR distances in near-constant time per comparison after training. Our contributions are fourfold. First, we build and publicly release a dataset of 864 phylogenetic trees inferred with UPGMA and Neighbor-Joining over four bacterial species, spanning up to 9{,}500 isolates, together with 388 labelled tree pairs. Second, we establish a reproducible pre-processing pipeline including midpoint re-rooting, which reduces tree depth and supplies the rooting required for exact distance computation and for the model's root-based features. Third, we validate the supervision target: on small trees, where exact SPR is tractable, the unrooted phangorn::SPR.dist heuristic correlates almost perfectly with the exact rooted distance computed by rspr (Pearson $0.98$--$0.99$), making it an excellent monotonic surrogate. Lastly, we train a Siamese Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN) regressor. In-distribution, i.e., held-out trees from the same species and size range as training, it explains roughly 87--90% of the variance ($R^2 \approx 0.87$ on a held-out split; $0.90 \pm 0.19$ under stratified cross-validation), with about four times lower error than a mean-predictor baseline, and shows partial transfer to unseen species ($R^2 \approx 0.37$). Its main limitation is extrapolation to trees larger than those seen in training, where accuracy collapses. The released dataset and the validated heuristic versus exact relationship provide a reproducible basis for scaling learned SPR approximation.
2607.18311.paper_summary_zh: 比較系統發育樹的拓撲結構對於理解流行病動態至關重要，但像子樹修剪與再接合（SPR）距離這樣具有生物學意義的距離計算是 NP-hard，並且在大型數據集上難以處理。<lb/>我們研究一個圖神經網絡（GNN）是否可以在訓練後以近乎恆定的時間來近似 SPR 距離。<lb/>我們的貢獻有四個方面。<lb/>首先，我們建立並公開發布了一個數據集，包含 864 個通過 UPGMA 和鄰接結合推斷的系統發育樹，涵蓋四種細菌物種，總計多達 9,500 個分離株，以及 388 對標記的樹對。<lb/>其次，我們建立了一個可重複的預處理管道，包括中點重新根植，這減少了樹的深度並提供了進行精確距離計算和模型根基特徵所需的根植。<lb/>第三，我們驗證了監督目標：在小樹上，精確的 SPR 是可處理的，無根的 phangorn::SPR.dist 問題與 rspr 計算的精確根距離幾乎完美相關（Pearson $0.98$--$0.99$），使其成為一個優秀的單調替代品。<lb/>最後，我們訓練了一個孿生圖同構網絡（GIN）回歸模型。在分佈內，即來自相同物種和大小範圍的保留樹上，它解釋了大約 87--90% 的變異（$R^2 \approx 0.87$ 在保留分割上；$0.90 \pm 0.19$ 在分層交叉驗證下），其誤差約為均值預測基線的四分之一，並顯示對未見物種的部分轉移（$R^2 \approx 0.37$）。<lb/>其主要限制是對於訓練中未見過的較大樹的外推，準確性會崩潰。<lb/>發布的數據集和經驗驗證的啟發式與精確關係提供了一個可重複的基礎，以擴展學習的 SPR 近似。
